summary: SU Group Holdings Ltd furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) reporting unaudited, unreviewed interim condensed consolidated results for the six months ended March 31, 2026, plus a press release. Revenue fell 20.0% to HK$86.3 million, cost of revenue declined 20.3% to HK$68.5 million, and gross profit dropped 18.8% to HK$17.8 million on contract-size mix. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated; the filing is routine periodic disclosure, not a special situation.
